case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.subject: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
sup:DEMO-F1.body:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

It is always a pleasure to work with your esteemed house, continuing the strong tradition of craftsmanship and trust between our companies. For this agreement, our offer stands at a price of €52.90 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. 

To remain transparent about our situation, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. We take great pride in the dedication of our foundry workforce and the quality we deliver to our partners every day.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to continuing our successful cooperation together.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Dear Mr. Moser,

Thank you for your offer and for the open explanation of your labour costs. We value the craftsmanship your foundry team delivers and would like to continue building on this partnership.

We cannot meet your proposed price, but we have put together three options that we hope work for both sides. A longer contract term gives you planning security, and two of the options offer a longer payment term while one keeps your current one.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 46.39; payment 30 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-01-01.
Option B: unit price EUR 46.25; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2027-04-01.
Option C: unit price EUR 46.64; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; new price valid from 2026-12-01.

Please let us know which option suits you best.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

We appreciate your constructive approach and the proposal of a 24-month contract, which provides valuable planning security for both our houses. We are prepared to accept the terms of your Option A, including the start date of 1 January 2027 and the 30-day payment term. 

However, to maintain the high quality you expect from our foundry, we propose a unit price of €51.40 for this package. 

To summarize our Angebot, we propose a price of €51.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 January 2027. This proposal stays valid for 30 days.

We are happy to discuss this in a call; until then our offer stands.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

message.subject: Re: Quote from Demo Gießerei GmbH: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
message.body:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

Our family-run foundry deeply values the long-standing relationship between our companies in this region. We welcome your suggestion to discuss the volume forecast by phone and look forward to arranging this meeting. 

To move forward, we are prepared to accept the earlier effective date of 1 December 2026 from your Option A. In exchange for this adjustment, we can lower our price to €50.90 per unit while keeping the 30-day payment term. This quote reflects a price of €50.90 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Please note that our offer remains valid for 30 days. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
